name: macOS
description: A menu bar, a window and a Dock around each scene: the menu and the Dock open the scene list and its settings, the traffic lights close, hide or unframe the window, and the clock opens the frame's page. On a Raspberry Pi every scene opens in a window of its own, with the frame's scenes in the Dock.

name: Windows 98
description: A gray taskbar below each scene: Start opens the scene list, the gear its settings, and the tray with the signal, the battery and the clock the frame's. On a Raspberry Pi it is a desktop: every scene opened is a window, all running at once, moved, sized, maximized or full screen with the mouse.
